_comment: The tile race Discord provisioning seam. api-backend publishes `command` on the Valkey channel; discord-server consumes it, acts on the guild, and POSTs `result` back to /tilerace/events/{event_id}/discord/result with the METRICS_API_KEY as a verification-code header. Every command carries the full desired shape, never a diff. Asserted by api-backend/app/tests/test_tilerace_discord.py and discord-server/tests/test_tilerace_contract.py.
_permissions_comment: `command.permissions` holds the event-wide elevated grants for a team's own role in its own channels. Every toggle is always present and always a bool. Each one only grants: an off toggle leaves the flag inherited, never denied. The bot applies them with set_permissions on the existing channel, so a toggle change never recreates a channel. `pin_messages` is Discord's own narrow permission (discord.py 2.7), deliberately separate from `manage_messages`.
